pages.text: Tier 1 bosses are found in Overworld structures. They are manageable in iron/copper gear but require active dodging. None drop Simply Swords uniques — those begin at Tier 2.

$(bold)Mutant Zombie$(/bold) (Mutant Monsters)$(br)Overworld, structures and open world. Drops: Mutant Zombie Chunks, Tier 1 tokens.$(br2)$(bold)Mutant Skeleton$(/bold) (Mutant Monsters)$(br)Overworld. Drops: Mutant Skeleton Shards, Tier 1 tokens.$(br2)$(bold)Mutant Spider$(/bold) (Mutant Monsters)$(br)Overworld. Drops: Mutant Spider Eyes, Tier 1 tokens.

$(bold)Iron's Spellbooks Mini-Bosses$(/bold)$(br)Archevoker, Cryomancer, Necromancer, Pyromancer appear in Overworld structures and villages. 25% chance for Tier 2 token peek.$(br2)$(bold)Brutal Bosses (Overworld)$(/bold)$(br)Champion-level mobs guarding Overworld dungeons. Variable drops. Tier 1 tokens guaranteed.
